canada.title: B.C. Green Leader Emily Lowan elected, but party fails to make gains
canada.summary: Voters have sent B.C. Greens Leader Emily Lowan to the legislature, CBC News projects, but the party failed to make significant gains in Saturday's provincial election.

canada.summary: This is a busy month for the Yukon Anti-Poverty Coalition, as the NGO launched one its largest campaigns of the year, and also marks its 30th anniversary.

canada.title: This Nova Scotian just ran his first marathon. He trained for it by eating donairs
canada.summary: David Wadden ran and biked to 59 donair shops in the Halifax area this year to eat donairs and rate them as part of a charity fundraiser. But that wasn't the hard part. After eating the donair, he faced the ungodly task of running or biking back home.

canada.summary: A 61-year-old has died following a two-vehicle collision on Highway 404 in Toronto, according to provincial police.

canada.title: Taking the road less travelled by: Montreal rideshare driver releases poetry collection
canada.summary: After eight years of balancing 10-hour workdays and writing, Jibril Adamu is releasing his first poetry collection, Ode to a Red Country Rooster, at the end of the month.

canada.title: There’s disappointment and hope among Albertans who supported the idea of independence
canada.summary: Now that the results of the referendum have come in, with three-quarters of Albertans voting to stay in Canada, we reached out to some residents who supported the other side to see how they feel and what they think happens next.

canada.title: Plains Cree musician says routine traffic stop with RCMP turned into violent encounter
canada.summary: Country musician Jarrid Poitras says he hasn't picked up a guitar since an RCMP officer dislocated his shoulder during a late-night highway traffic stop near Prince Albert two weeks ago. He wants to know why the province's police watchdog is not investigating.

canada.title: As the Sask. legislature returns, will Premier Scott Moe's focus on 'strong and steady' leadership be enough?
canada.summary: The new legislative session will begin with a speech from the throne laying out the Saskatchewan Party's priorities. Experts say both the government and the Opposition need to paint pictures of their visions for the province.

canada.title: Rare disease linked to gene in people with Black Loyalist lineage
canada.summary: New research reveals a hereditary connection between a rare, life-threatening heart disease and Black Loyalist lineage in Atlantic Canada.

canada.title: Lorne Doerkson to become next B.C. premier amid projected majority win for Conservatives
canada.summary: The B.C. Conservatives will form a majority government, CBC News projects, with Lorne Doerkson to be the next premier.

canada.title: N.L. Liberals, NDP want ‘action’ from government during House of Assembly's fall sitting
canada.summary: N.L. Premier Tony Wakeham says his government has a heavy legislative agenda planned for the House of Assembly’s upcoming fall sitting — kicking off on Monday — but what exactly those bills entail are details he didn’t share.

canada.title: N.L. government doesn't yet know who's paying for its new dry dock
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador took the next step towards construction of a new dry dock and marine industrial facility on Friday, as the Oil and Gas Corporation of Newfoundland and Labrador issued a Request for Proposals on the project and construction at the Bull Arm Fabrication Site. The project — at this point — has the public treasury on the hook for hundreds of millions of dollars in cost to cover.

canada.title: Is this Quebec-developed fruit the 'apple of the future'?
canada.summary: Quebec apple producers say it’s been a good season, harvest- and sales-wise. They say it has much to do with U.S. tariffs and new varieties developed in — and for — Quebec.
